title: How Fonderie controls the AI
lede: Fonderie ships a playbook — a set of instructions — that lives in your repo. When your AI looks at your project, it reads Fonderie's guide first.

steps.title: Your playbook ships with your code
steps.text: A single file tells your AI exactly what to build and which pieces to use.

steps.title: Any AI follows the same guide
steps.text: Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any AI gets the exact same instructions. Switch tools anytime without rebuilding your product.

steps.title: Fonderie verifies the output
steps.text: Types and tests catch errors before they ship. Correct by construction.

steps.title: You review and ship
steps.text: You own the code. Customize the UI, add your logic, deploy.
